cards.summary: Picking among N sampled chunks by their flow residual under the pre-commit observation fits what happens next better than a random or stale pick, with no added control-step delay.

cards.title: Horizon × depth (Euler steps vs execution horizon)
cards.summary: With long open-loop commitment, cutting a flow-matching VLA's Euler steps from 10 to 2 contracts the action cloud around an unchanged centroid, saves most of the inference time and avoids edge-GPU thermal throttling.

cards.title: REMORA
cards.summary: Reading a progress distribution out at the supported peak nearest the previous estimate steadies the estimate and lets it fall during real setbacks, with no worse detection of the stages.
